required_evidence: Reviewed task spec with exact files interfaces and acceptance criteria
failure_condition: Implementation exceeds declared scope or leaves ambiguous behavior

required_evidence: Fresh production-binary build log at reviewed commit
failure_condition: Only a library package or cached target was built

required_evidence: Runtime tool enumeration matched to an approved manifest
failure_condition: New package has no registered runtime capability

required_evidence: Happy-path and invalid-input invocation for every added tool
failure_condition: Handler exists without executable contract coverage

required_evidence: Uncached unit and integration results plus race/static checks where applicable
failure_condition: A required suite is skipped cached or failing

required_evidence: Idempotency and authorization evidence for state-changing tools
failure_condition: Retry can duplicate effects or expand authority

required_evidence: Constructor fan-in file size and coupling thresholds
failure_condition: Change worsens a blocked architecture threshold

required_evidence: Model spec diff repair count reviewers and final decision retained
One authoritative gate reconciles all parallel review findings
failure_condition: Feature merges while any required finding remains unresolved
